run_xarm_simulation: run the pybullet xarm6 robot simulation with GUI sliders to control each joint position
load_urdf_robot: load an xarm6 robot URDF and a table URDF into a pybullet simulation environment
enumerate_robot_joints: enumerate all prismatic and revolute joints on a loaded pybullet robot using getJointInfo
control_joints_with_debug_params: control robot joint positions in real time using pybullet user debug parameter sliders
capture_camera_frames: capture periodic camera images from the pybullet simulation using ER_BULLET_HARDWARE_OPENGL renderer
